title: How to Create Resume Bullet Points with ChatGPT | AI Resume Tips
description:
You can write your resume bullet points with ChatGPT to make your job search more efficient—but there are a few important things to know if you do. (Tip #1: Always edit before submitting! AI can't possibly know exactly what you've done.) 

With tools like ChatGPT, you can transform your resume from generic to tailored and specific. In today's market, having an intentional, tailored resume will make more impact and get you to that interview.

So let's break down how to use ChatGPT step-by-step to create resume achievements. (Or how you can do the same thing even faster using a purpose-built tool like @teal_hq.) 

Your achievements explain what you know, how you know it, and how you've applied it in your experience.

Want to learn more in-depth on utilizing ChatGPT to write your resume? Check out the linked video and read up on our latest ChatGPT article here: https://www.tealhq.com/post/3-ways-to-use-chatgpt-ai-for-your-job-search

Need to skip ahead? Check out the chapter highlights below:

00:29 What you need for this
00:52 Looking at our "before" resume bullet
01:36 Improving our achievement with ChatGPT
